how-31-01-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the fish, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-31-01-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the fish, then tap three things you notice.

how-31-01-compare.page: Put the plant strip on one shore and the bare dirt on the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Make it rain. Then swap.
how-31-01-compare.say: Put the plant strip on one shore and the bare dirt on the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Make it rain. Then swap.

how-31-01-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.
how-31-01-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.

how-31-01-det.page: Pick 3 cards, one at a time. Tap the clue that shows the problem, then name the threat. Predict what could help, and see how people are fixing it.
how-31-01-det.say: Pick three cards, one at a time. Tap the clue that shows the problem, then name the threat. Predict what could help, and see how people are fixing it.

how-31-01-partc.page: Draw a Florida wetland ecosystem. Show one threat happening in your drawing. Label at least 4 things: at least one plant, one animal, and the source of the threat.
how-31-01-partc.say: Draw a Florida wetland ecosystem. Show one threat happening in your drawing. Label at least 4 things: at least one plant, one animal, and the source of the threat.
